name: grit-expert
description: Twenty-four Claude skills that build a product on the Grit framework: a router that reads your project and assigns the work, one expert per architecture (triple, double, single, desktop, mobile), and specialists for resources, plugins, blueprints, the admin panel, design, data, security, performance, deployment and review, plus a report on whether the experts are actually paying for themselves and one that reads, from Claude Code's own transcripts, what the work cost in tokens and which tool spent them, and a developer advocate that watches the build and files what is worth telling people about as a story with a draft and a channel, and an independent critic that reviews a feature somebody has marked done. They read the docs out of your installed grit binary rather than from memory, interview you once and remember the answers, and file what Grit got wrong as an issue while they work.
